edit.text: At the Temple of the Forgotten, Sarge, now fully Pachakutiq, overpowers Mack, until May tosses Mack the sword Sarge stabbed her with and Mack kills him with it.
Jiaying begs S.H.I.E.L.D. to bring Kora back to her from Afterlife, but Nathaniel Malick, the man Kora turned on her to follow, kills Jiaying at the Lighthouse.
When Mojo comes to Earth to stage a televised hunt of the X-Men, he captures Jubilee, and the X-Men fight through his show to rescue her.
Sinister works with Beast, Forge and Warlock on Muir Island to make the virus that destroys the Phalanx.
edit.whoA: An unlikely ally. Helps Beast make the virus that destroys the Phalanx.
edit.whoB: Makes the virus against the Phalanx with Sinister.

edit.text: During the battle at Cybertek, Hydra forces Deathlok to turn his weapons on Nick Fury and Phil Coulson. Once Mike breaks free of John Garrett's hold, he strikes Garrett down while Fury looks on.
edit.whoB: Forced by Hydra to target Fury at Cybertek. Once free, strikes Garrett down as Fury looks on.

edit.text: Raina approaches Carl Creel about the Obelisk he has stolen for HYDRA, offering him a carbyne ring that would protect him from its touch. Creel refuses her deal and warns her off, but keeps the ring.
edit.whoA: A rival for the Obelisk who offers Creel a carbyne ring. He keeps it but refuses her deal.
edit.whoB: HYDRA's man holding the Obelisk, who refuses Raina's deal but keeps her carbyne ring.

edit.text: Sunil Bakshi is Daniel Whitehall's fiercely loyal second in command. He carries out Whitehall's campaign to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D. and recover the Obelisk.
edit.whoB: Bakshi's leader, whom he serves with fierce loyalty.

edit.text: Lance Hunter and Bobbi Morse are exes who were once married, and they bicker constantly.

Yo-Yo and Lincoln Campbell fight side by side in Daisy's Secret Warriors and bring in Gideon Malick, and they stand up to Coulson when he suspects one of them is under Hive's control. When the Kree device turns up in Lincoln's locker, Yo-Yo tries to take him down, and his electricity knocks her out.
When Aida turns on Fitz in the containment chamber they are locked in together, Piper is one of the agents who pull him out, and she gets him away to the Zephyr.
edit.whoB: A scientist Piper pulls out of Aida's chamber and gets to the Zephyr.

edit.text: Ruby Hale is raised to see Quake as the rival she must beat to earn her mother's approval. When Daisy saves Coulson and Talbot from her, Ruby tells Daisy she wants to beat her and attacks with her chakram, but Daisy knocks her out.
edit.whoA: Hale's daughter, raised to beat Quake. Attacks Daisy with a chakram and loses.

edit.text: Maggie is Cassie's mother. She raises Cassie with her fiance Jim Paxton and tells Scott that if he wants to see their daughter, he must get a job and a place and pay child support, and be the hero Cassie already thinks he is.
edit.whoB: Maggie's daughter. Maggie tells Scott to be the hero Cassie thinks he is.

edit.whoA: The Orgoscope's security chief, whom Mantis kicks down before he forces her surrender.

edit.text: Bruce is recruited to the Avengers after Loki takes Clint under his control. Once Clint is freed, they fight side by side in the Battle of New York.
Loki takes over Clint's mind, and Clint leads the attack on the Helicarrier that lets Loki escape. Loki kills Coulson during the escape.
edit.whoA: A longtime colleague, killed by Loki in the Helicarrier attack Clint leads.
edit.whoB: A longtime colleague. Under Loki's control, leads the Helicarrier attack in which Coulson dies.

edit.text: Loki is the Grandmaster's favorite, but when he interrupts the Grandmaster, Topaz hands over the Melt Stick to have him killed. The Grandmaster refuses.
edit.whoA: The Grandmaster's bodyguard, who offers the Melt Stick to have Loki killed.
edit.whoB: A favorite of the Grandmaster, whom Topaz wants melted for interrupting.

edit.text: Madani tracks Curtis to the RV where he is looking after Amy Bendix and presses him to give up Frank. He says he does not know where Frank is, and they end up sharing a drink.
edit.whoA: An agent who tracks Curtis to the RV and presses him to give up Frank.
edit.whoB: Frank's friend, looking after Amy when Madani tracks him down.

edit.text: Trevor stops cooperating and, as the Mandarin, sends news outlets a video claiming the set explosion to cover for Simon. Cleary arrests him and sends him to a Damage Control prison.
Charlotte, a pureblood elder of his house, comes to confront Marcus about his Aurora Project.
edit.whoA: The pureblood elder who confronts Marcus about Aurora.
edit.whoB: The ambitious vampire Charlotte confronts about Aurora.

edit.text: Frank's wife, son and parents are killed by Howard Saint's men at a family reunion in Puerto Rico. Their deaths make him the Punisher.
Keene Marlow, an old friend of Ben's, visits May after Peter's wedding, and she introduces him to Peter.
On their honeymoon, Mary Jane turns out to be a clone made by Miles Warren, and she dissolves. Peter then sets out with Madame Web to find the real Mary Jane.

As Venom, Eddie tries to unmask Spider-Man in public and force a gene cleanser down his throat. Spider-Man shoves it down Venom's throat instead, stripping the symbiote away, and Eddie is taken away vowing revenge.

edit.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#7
edit.text: Norman is Harry's cold, ruthless father, and Spider-Man saves him from the Vulture. Meanwhile a masked Green Goblin sets out to take over New York's underworld from the Big Man and tries to kill Spider-Man.
edit.whoB: The hero who saves Norman from the Vulture.

edit.text: When Norman visits Otto in prison to gloat that he tipped off Ross and that Oscorp is taking Otto's inventions, Otto lashes out at him for living off other people's work.
Jeanne is Daredevil's partner, the hero Finesse. She has been undercover as an Oscorp intern to spy on Norman for him, and now he asks her to keep an eye on Harry too.
